new.statement: Survival-genre games earn a lower Top Earning position for their CCU than other genres
Young games that sell currency packs climb Top Trending faster than those that don't
PvP loops climb Top Trending more slowly than other young games of similar age
new.action: Launch co-op or party, not PvP

new.statement: Games whose median developer product costs more than 79 Robux stay on Most Popular longer
new.action: Price most dev products above 79 R$

new.statement: Duel-pad first-person shooters (Sniper Duels, Murder Duels, Deagle Arena, RIVALS) form a durable sub-genre that holds both Most Popular and Top Earning with skin-and-trade economies instead of passes
new.rationale: Today's profiling found four duel-pad FPS games with zero or few passes and large currency/skin product lists, each on Top Earning or Most Popular. Needs a loop/feature tag for duel pads and several weeks of presence data to confirm.

qualitative_updates.note: Cross-chart entries keep the order: uc->tt (17, median 2d) and uc->te (10, 1d) lead, and tt->mp (10, 2d) remains the main road into Most Popular.
Today every game's CCU came from a single snapshot (the hourly file had under 6 hours of readings), so efficiency extremes below ~1,000 CCU again rest on one reading.
